scope: Six production Kasa dashboards; every panel, target and enabled Prometheus annotation.

tests.promtool: PASS: cost integration, deduplication, percentages, anomaly zero variance, collection failure alerts, battery energy balance, forecast warmup

limitations: Empty results are not counted as query passes. Historical data and forecast training windows must refill after cutover.
Costs use configured tariffs, not a verified utility bill. Solar/battery values are scenarios, not telemetry.
The TPAP dependency is an exact unreleased upstream commit; release migration tracked as TALOS-ss7f.
Legacy development-source migration is preserved in the original dirty checkout; completion tracked as TALOS-oq7x.

panels.title: Illustrative charge scenarios since range start
panels.description: Modeled charge using sampled observed load since range start. Missing load data understates discharge. Starts full for discharge/net curves and empty for solar-only charge. Solar assumes continuous configured output, not actual irradiance. This is not battery telemetry. Charge uses nominal battery energy, solar input is reduced by efficiency, and AC load is divided by efficiency. The same efficiency setting approximates charging and discharging losses. The discharge-floor line follows the selected depth of discharge.

queries.expression_template: clamp_min(100 - ((sum_over_time((sum(max by(device_id,alias,version)(current_consumption{job="kasa-exporter",alias=~"${device}",version=~"${version}"})) and on() (vector(time()) >= ${__from:date:seconds}))[$__range:30s]) - last_over_time((sum(max by(device_id,alias,version)(current_consumption{job="kasa-exporter",alias=~"${device}",version=~"${version}"})) and on() (vector(time()) >= ${__from:date:seconds}))[$__range:30s])) * 30 / 3600) / ($battery_voltage * $battery_capacity_ah * $inverter_efficiency) * 100, 0)

clamp_max(clamp_min(100 + ((($solar_panel_watts * $inverter_efficiency) * clamp_min(vector(time() - ${__from:date:seconds}), 0) / 3600) - (((sum_over_time((sum(max by(device_id,alias,version)(current_consumption{job="kasa-exporter",alias=~"${device}",version=~"${version}"})) and on() (vector(time()) >= ${__from:date:seconds}))[$__range:30s]) - last_over_time((sum(max by(device_id,alias,version)(current_consumption{job="kasa-exporter",alias=~"${device}",version=~"${version}"})) and on() (vector(time()) >= ${__from:date:seconds}))[$__range:30s])) * 30 / 3600) / $inverter_efficiency)) / ($battery_voltage * $battery_capacity_ah) * 100, 0), 100)
